newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takefuji shares down on loss-cut sales.
newsitem.headline: Takefuji shares down on loss-cut sales.

text.p: Shares in consumer finance firm Takefuji Corp were depressed in Tuesday afternoon trade after investors sold the shares to minimise losses, brokers said.
As of 0515 GMT, the shares stood at 8,900 yen, after closing at 9,010 yen on Monday. Earlier in the day, they fell as low as 8,860 yen.
Brokers said the lack of buying incentives was making investors sell.
They also said anonymous allegations circulating in the market charging impropriety by some Takefuji executives had scared investors into selling their shares.
"We are aware of the allegations," a public relations official at Takefuji said. "The accusations are entirely false, and we are annoyed by the anonymous allegations."
